goal: Make every successful existing Parallel hot-Lua watcher apply end with a visible in-game chat acknowledgement so a tester can tell that the live client actually executed the changed payload.
notes: Native watcher emits a green [W112 HOT] OK #N line only after FrameScriptExecute reports success for a changed watched payload. Cold baseline seeding does not emit a ping. Current watched routes are SummonScout postpay/AH host, whisper host and hot-transformed SummonScout core. This is an acknowledgement layer only; no summon, AH, login retry or payload scheduling behavior is changed. Exact feature integration is opted into the serialized Parallel queue after preflight plus the autologinbridge profile gate pass.
